title: Maguindanao village chief survives 17 bullets in daylight ambush

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – A Maguindanao del Norte village chairman has miraculously survived 17 bullets fired by riding-in-tandem suspects in a daylight ambush in Barangay Awang, Datu Odin Sinsuat town on Tuesday afternoon. Municipal Mayor Abdulmain “Baba” Abas said Barangay Dinaig Proper chairperson Ahmad Jabiden sustained a very minor wound on his belly. Abas said Jabiden is already in stable condition.
